author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

The season for wild greens is incredibly short, and their freshest moment is hard to catch. Once you miss this season, you have to wait another whole year. Hidden in the mountains and fields, these spring delicacies are tender, juicy, delicately fresh, and richly flavorful. Whether dressed cold, quickly stir-fried, or simmered into soup, they are all true earthly delights. Our love for gathering wild greens is no less than our love for gathering wild mushrooms, and their deliciousness is no less than that of mushrooms.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
